blocks.text: Inspections grouped by site_id, one group per yard or cross-dock.
Delivered as a daily file or a feed, whichever Ducal prefers. Ducal's choice.
Out of scope for Friday's demo. We say that plainly.
Every record already carries a site_id, so nothing new is needed on the device.
Need from Ducal: what their freight system can take in, and who on their side looks after it.
Mesh Routing is down: the queue holds. Inspectors keep making and signing inspections, and they go out when it's back.
Tablet lost or broken before it syncs: those inspections are lost. Same as losing a clipboard of paper today. We say so up front, not in small print.
Duplicate send: every event carries an id made on the device, and the receiver ignores repeats. Sending twice does no harm.
